name: Alice the Wonder
description: A young prodigy with unbelievable promise. Excels at setting up powerful comboes with mana-intensive cards.

name: Anzia the Yeek
description: A mysterious figure who may not be who she claims to be. Excels at disrupting the opponent's strategy through unorthodox means.

name: Bertcalf the Tall
description: A man with a dark past and an equally dark future. Excels at dominating short rounds.

name: Lutis the Mad
description: A powerful mage whose twisted tale of heartbreak has lead him to regions unknown. Excels at annihilating a single enemy threat.

name: Newtonia the White
description: A human-sized doll with the power of a demigod. Excels at playing additional cards to set up powerful card combinations.

name: Octicia the Cunning
description: A cursed child attempting to avert a disastrous fate. Excels at nudging weak enemy threats to their demise.

name: Rhodango the Red
description: An eccentric hermit with a passion for flora and fauna. Excels at maintaining a presence in more than one round.

name: Samray the Swift
description: A farsighted mage who has chosen to respond bravely to a terrifying vision of the future. Excels at improving the cards in one's hand.

name: Takulev the Undying
description: A cold-blooded revenant with strange motives. Excels at reintroducing defeated threats.

name: Vizimir the Golden
description: A powerful mage and alchemist with a heart for compassion and wisdom. Excels at dominating a single, long round.
